mentions.name: Tootterhalf
mentions.description: Web app for creating interactive Valentine's Day invitations: users pick from a set of templates, add their own message or photo, and share the result easily. A CMS feature is being added so users can edit their info directly on the site and get a shareable link instead of self-hosting or editing code.
mentions.audience: Individuals creating Valentine's Day invitations for their special someone
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on this project, which lets you create interactive Valentine’s Day invitations for your special someone. You can pick from a set of templates, add your own message or photo, and share it easily.
